headline: Unit economics look artificially resilient because WhatsApp conversation markup fees are excluded from CAC.

findings.title: Aggressive CAC break point leaves only 36% margin of error
findings.detail: Deck assumes CAC of ₹2,500 with 18 months runway. However, our deterministic sensitivity engine proves runway collapses below 12 months if CAC increases to ₹3,410 (+36%).

sources.quote: runway collapses to 11.8 months at CAC ₹3,410

findings.question: If paid acquisition on Meta scales up and customer acquisition cost rises from ₹2,500 to ₹3,500, what cohort data proves your unit economics won't instantly turn negative?
findings.missing_proof: Historical 6-month cohort retention and blended CAC ledger broken down by channel

findings.title: Meta conversation fee escalation unmodeled in Gross Margin
findings.detail: Meta charges per-marketing-conversation rates on WhatsApp Business API (~₹0.78 per message in India). At high chat frequency, gross margin will decline from 75% towards 52%.

sources.quote: WhatsApp Business Cloud API India rate card

findings.question: How many WhatsApp messages per customer per month are included in your ₹3,500 subscription before your 75% gross margin turns unprofitable?
findings.missing_proof: WhatsApp BSP conversation billing invoices showing average message costs per active merchant

findings.title: Unrealistic monthly churn assumption for SME retail sector
findings.detail: Deck assumes 4.5% monthly churn for micro-enterprises. Indian retail SaaS typically suffers 7-10% monthly churn due to seasonal business closures.
findings.question: What is your 90-day logo churn among micro-retailers outside tier-1 cities?
findings.missing_proof: Cohort retention curve for the first 180 paying MSMEs over 6 months

findings.title: Overly optimistic collection efficiency for monthly recurring fees
findings.detail: SME subscriptions paid via UPI autopay in India frequently experience payment mandate drop-offs of 15-20%.
findings.question: What percentage of monthly UPI recurring mandates fail at renewal, and how does that impact ARPU collection?
findings.missing_proof: Payment gateway collection success rate report from Razorpay/Cashfree

headline: The claim of 'no direct competitors' is provably false, with well-funded incumbents already active in Indian WhatsApp commerce.

findings.title: Unsubstantiated 'No Direct Competitors' claim directly refuted by market data
findings.detail: Slide 4 claims zero direct competitors. Live web grounding found LimeChat ($4.2M funded by Stellaris) and BiteSpeed ($3.4M funded by Peak XV Surge) targeting identical WhatsApp sales automation.

sources.quote: conversational commerce platform enabling WhatsApp catalog checkouts for Indian merchants
omnichannel conversational sales assistant powering store catalog ordering

findings.question: How can you claim no direct competitors when LimeChat and BiteSpeed have raised over $7M and offer direct WhatsApp catalog checkouts in India?
findings.missing_proof: Head-to-head feature and pricing matrix comparing BolBot against LimeChat and BiteSpeed

findings.title: Contradictory and constrained TAM sizing
findings.detail: Deck claims a ₹500 crore total addressable market. Industry reports size Indian conversational commerce at $1.2B (~₹9,960 Cr). Sizing is either 20x too small or conflating TAM with SOM.

sources.quote: Indian conversational commerce ecosystem is expanding at 38% CAGR towards $1.2 billion

findings.question: Is your ₹500 Cr market claim bottom-up or top-down, and why is it disconnected from the $1.2B broader conversational commerce reports?
findings.missing_proof: Bottom-up TAM build showing target merchant count multiplied by expected annual contract value

findings.title: Distribution bottleneck in non-metro merchant acquisition
findings.detail: Acquiring Indian MSMEs through pure digital ads historically hits a ceiling quickly; field-sales distribution costs are omitted.

sources.quote: SME sales distribution across Tier 2/3 clusters

findings.question: What is your customer acquisition channel mix between digital performance marketing and feet-on-street merchant sales?
findings.missing_proof: Signed channel partner agreements or field distributor pilot contracts

findings.title: Platform dependency risk on Meta WhatsApp Cloud API policies
findings.detail: Meta frequently modifies commerce template guidelines and promotional message broadcast caps without notice.

sources.quote: Meta WhatsApp Business Platform messaging terms

findings.question: What protects BolBot from being commoditized if Meta expands native WhatsApp catalog checkout tools directly for merchants?
findings.missing_proof: Official Meta Business Partner certification or multi-channel failover roadmap

headline: No proof of proprietary voice ASR models; system appears to wrap third-party APIs without a defensible IP moat.

findings.title: Lack of verifiable IP moat in Indic speech processing
findings.detail: Deck claims a 'proprietary multilingual voice-to-cart engine'. Public repository inspection reveals reliance on standard open-source libraries without custom model checkpoints or acoustic training data.
findings.question: What proprietary dataset was used to fine-tune your Indic voice engine, and where are your comparative word-error-rate (WER) benchmarks against open-source Whisper and Bhashini?
findings.missing_proof: Model evaluation benchmark report and audio dataset IP ownership documentation

findings.title: Unsubstantiated automated two-way inventory sync
findings.detail: Deck asserts real-time inventory synchronization with Tally and Zoho Books, but live website and documentation lack any webhook specifications or desktop Tally TCP connectors.

sources.quote: Real-time sync with Tally and Zoho Books inventory

findings.question: Most Indian SMEs run on-premise desktop Tally without cloud APIs. How does your engine achieve real-time two-way stock synchronization without an on-premise Windows daemon?
findings.missing_proof: Architecture diagram and code repository for the Tally XML connector daemon

findings.title: Concurrency and rate-limiting bottlenecks on peak sale days
findings.detail: WhatsApp Cloud API imposes strict TPS rate limits. During festival flash sales (e.g. Diwali), order queues may delay or drop confirmation messages.

sources.quote: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API throughput limits

findings.question: What is the peak message throughput tested under load, and what message broker handles async retry queues?
findings.missing_proof: Load test report demonstrating message delivery times at 250+ concurrent customer sessions

findings.title: Data protection and customer privacy compliance under India DPDP Act
findings.detail: Customer shopping conversations and phone numbers stored in WhatsApp databases must adhere to Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) standards.
findings.question: How are customer contact numbers and payment screenshots encrypted at rest in accordance with the Indian DPDP Act?
findings.missing_proof: Security compliance architecture document and data retention policy
